module example.com/plainneg

go 1.27

-- pos/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

var sink = make(chan int, 4)

func group(x int) { sink <- x * 2 }

func scope(x int) int { return x + 1 }

func main() {
	yield := 6
	scopeV := scope(7)
	go group(8)
	errdefer := 9
	const k = 10
	g := <-sink
	fmt.Println(yield*1000 + scopeV*100 + g*10 + errdefer + k)
}

-- cfor/constfor.go --
package neg

func constFor() {
	const for i := range x {}
}

-- cif/constif.go --
package neg

func constIf(x int) int {
	const if x == 1 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

-- cswitch/constswitch.go --
package neg

func constSwitch[T any](v T) int {
	const switch T {
	case int:
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

-- cfunc/constfunc.go --
package neg

const func constFunc() {}

-- cmethod/constmethod.go --
package neg

type iface interface {
	const M() int
}

-- cq/question.go --
package neg

func question() {
	g()?
}

func g() {}

-- cqd/qdot.go --
package neg

type u struct{ x int }

func qdot(v *u) int {
	return v?.x
}

-- cqq/coal.go --
package neg

func coal(a, b int) int {
	return a ?? b
}

-- carr/arrow.go --
package neg

func arrow(x int) int {
	h := x => x + 1
	return h(x)
}

-- cix/interp.go --
package neg

func interp(name string) string {
	return $"hi {name}"
}
